basic.title: Storing and Retrieving Data
basic.description: Basic SET and GET operations using the Memcached protocol
basic.code:
$ telnet localhost 12333
Trying 127.0.0.1...
Connected to localhost.

set mykey 0 0 5
hello
STORED

get mykey
VALUE mykey 0 5
hello
END

basic.title: Delete Operation
basic.description: Remove a key from the store
basic.code:
delete mykey
DELETED

get mykey
END

advanced.title: Multiple Keys
advanced.description: Store and retrieve multiple key-value pairs
advanced.code:
set user:1 0 0 4
john
STORED

set user:2 0 0 4
jane
STORED

get user:1 user:2
VALUE user:1 0 4
john
VALUE user:2 0 4
jane
END

advanced.title: Conditional Operations
advanced.description: Use ADD and REPLACE for conditional storage
advanced.code:
add newkey 0 0 5
value
STORED

add newkey 0 0 6
value2
NOT_STORED

replace newkey 0 0 8
replaced
STORED
